name: laboratorio
description: Weekly cap on the Claude subscription quota your unattended sessions may use, WhatsApp alerts, and, as an extra, sessions that close their own PR on green CI.

usage_token.title: Usage token
usage_token.description: Token the weekly cap sends to the usage endpoint to read the week's percentage: the OAuth token of your claude login. You hand it over here; the plugin never reads it from your machine, prints it or stores it.
